rootCause: Screen-space atan2 defined positive motion as counterclockwise, then applied that sign directly to local +Z. The shipping camera observes the mechanism from the opposite axis hemisphere, so the resulting TopPlate motion was visually reversed.

fix.mapping: screen ray -> fixed-axis interaction plane -> world radial -> Vector3.SignedAngle around RotatingCarrier oriented local +Z
fix.gestureArbitration: At maximum travel, compare tangential arc travel with radial travel before choosing rotation. Straight closure remains slide.
fix.directionMetadata: Each DetentCrossed publishes its signed direction and unwrapped index to the controller, audio renderer, and Haptic router telemetry.
